name: Prefsbelt IV
description: Prefsbelt IV, also referred to as simply Prefsbelt, was a green planet in the Prefsbelt system, a star system in the Prefsbelt sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was notably the site of the ancient Republic—and later Imperial—Naval Academy.
